ZBM sir, One of the best faculties I’ve had—knowledgeable, approachable, and genuinely invested in students’ learning.His classes are well-structured, engaging.Although he teaches a lot of theory, his exams are mostly math-based. He gives partial credit generously — for example, even if you can’t solve a problem completely, you can still get around a good percentage of the marks if you use a valid formula and show some correct steps.he takes about 4–5 quizzes and counts the best 3–4. There are usually 3–4 assignments, and he also evaluates class performance through 3–4 short assessments, each worth 5 marks. Since he gives a lot of bonus marks, he doesn’t apply any grade curve. However he,also provides plenty of practice questions, many of which appear in the exams.
